This function iterates through each tuple in the info list. It skips every Fth tuple, so only the last tuple of every group of F tuples is processed. For each tuple it gets the number of words (len(data[1])) and sums the minimum of the length of each word (min(len(word), 30)) for all words, adding this to the result.

This function takes O(N) time complexity because it only makes a single pass through the input. Space complexity is O(1), because it doesn't use any extra space that grows with the size of N or F. This is efficient and will terminate within 30 seconds for any possible input.
